_meta.description: Alchemist subclass passives: 3 stat-based (max 20 levels each). Focus: DoT damage, debuff, survivability.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente les dégâts de 1.2% et la durée des debuffs de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases damage by 1.2% and debuff duration by 0.5% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente la pénétration magique de 0.8% et la chance d'appliquer des effets de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases magic penetration by 0.8% and effect chance by 0.5% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente les PV max de 0.8% et la résistance aux effets de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases max HP by 0.8% and effect resistance by 0.5% per level.
